# miniz / large_fuzzer

miniz's own fuzz target `large_fuzzer` ([source](source/large_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over miniz 3.1.2 (richgel999/miniz at 77d0dce8).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, an invariant: deflate(Z_NO_FLUSH) with ample output space must consume all input ('deflate not greedy' -> exit 1).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against miniz 3.1.2 at commit 77d0dce8.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- deflate(Z_NO_FLUSH) with ample output space must consume all input ('deflate not greedy' -> exit 1) ([lines 54-58](source/large_fuzzer.c#L54-L58)): exit(1); not confirmed in the binary.
- deflate(Z_FINISH) after feeding its own compressed output back in must report Z_STREAM_END; deflateInit/deflate/deflateEnd must return Z_OK ([lines 66-74](source/large_fuzzer.c#L66-L74)): exit(1); not confirmed in the binary.
- The deflate stream just produced must inflate to Z_STREAM_END without any inflate error (output discarded, not compared) ([lines 97-109](source/large_fuzzer.c#L97-L109)): exit(1); confirmed in the binary.

A failure of the check at lines 97-109 ends the process with a status that the halts statements below that name it exclude, so a proof of one of those statements implies it on every input it covers. No statement here proves the other checks.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch miniz` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `large_fuzzer.plain` | 71,704 | `15e287c69a3397e84ad019f0ed1df4875f620e952538cd29c30258bee5071ce4` |
| ubsan | `large_fuzzer.ubsan` | 77,600 | `d65e4668ea2aaffa346f87add897f07ca0826bfc18f0eb63736fd4f04f1efdcc` |
| asan | `large_fuzzer.asan` | 819,720 | `d9b5d36621899b5d8bde246db3513d258a25a1302ccc73a9d6541ac9b7055ea1` |
| asan-ubsan | `large_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 826,392 | `06498fcca07c8249c54ee613cc70ad3b26254624174a3e862192e236f964fd00` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
